'''Channe Dar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], serving in the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sector]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dar received a report from [[Mehar Grot]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of [[Alliance Base 16]] on [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]], that their location had been compromised by an [[espionage droid]].
